tasks.title: 和行銷顧問第一次開會

fills.en: We're ___ thinking of people who work from home.

fills.en: Most consumers find the compact design ___.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, who do you see buying these lamps in the end?

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We're mainly thinking of people who work from home.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Agreed. It's compact, so it fits on any desk.
scene.zh: 同意。它很小巧，什麼桌子都放得下。

passages.title: Lantern Survey: Summary of Results
lines: Here is a short summary of our survey.

We sent the questionnaire to 2,400 subscribers of the Harbor Trading website, and 612 people answered. Most of them browse the website at least once a month. Many of them work from home two or three days a week. Answers were similar across age and gender.
First, price: 58 percent of respondents would pay $45 or less for a desk lamp, so the series has to be affordable.

Second, design: most respondents said their current lamp looks outdated. They want something compact and attractive for a small home office. They liked the soft light and the smooth movement of the arm, and the frame's light weight was the most popular characteristic.
Third, "Made in Taiwan" is widely seen as a sign of good quality, so this perception can help us.
I think these results are good news for Lantern. Next step: we will use them to write the brand message.

questions.en: How much would most respondents pay for a desk lamp?
questions.zh: 大部分填答者願意花多少錢買一盞檯燈？

questions.en: Which characteristic was the most popular?
questions.zh: 最受歡迎的特點是哪一個？

questions.en: How do people see "Made in Taiwan"?
options: As a sign of good quality

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The survey results are in. Here's my summary.
scene.zh: 問卷結果出來了。這是我寫的摘要。

scene.en: Three clear trends emerged, and the first one surprised me.
scene.zh: 有三個很明顯的趨勢，第一個讓我很意外。

scene.speaker: player

scene.zh: 結果顯示，價格比我們原本想的還重要。

scene.zh: 對。這個系列一定要價格實惠，大約 45 美元以下。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 大家也很喜歡柔和的燈光和輕巧的燈架。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And "Made in Taiwan" is widely seen as good quality.
scene.zh: 而且大家普遍覺得「台灣製造」代表品質好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That perception can really help us.
scene.zh: 這個印象對我們會很有幫助。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: The results show that price matters more than we thought.
scene.zh: 結果顯示，價格比我們原本想的還重要。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's useful. And what about the slogan?
scene.zh: 這很有用。那標語呢？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here's my latest: "Lantern. Light for the way you work."
scene.zh: 這是我最新的版本：「Lantern，為你的工作方式而亮。」

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can we try a version that sounds a little warmer?
scene.zh: 可以換一個聽起來溫暖一點的版本試試看嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Fair enough. How about "A warm light for every home"?
scene.zh: 也對。那「給每個家一盞溫暖的燈」怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Much better. Now, Mr. Ellis loves magazine ads.
scene.zh: 好多了。對了，Ellis 先生很喜歡雜誌廣告。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Although magazine ads look nice, they're hard to measure.
scene.zh: 雖然雜誌廣告看起來很漂亮，但效果很難評估。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Fine. And that supermarket chain with the $20 lamps?
scene.zh: 好吧。那家賣 20 美元檯燈的連鎖超市呢？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: We can't beat them on price, so let's compete on design.
scene.zh: 價格我們拚不過他們，那就用設計來競爭吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Agreed. Last question: when do we launch?
scene.zh: 同意。最後一個問題：什麼時候上市？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How about launching the series in early May?
scene.zh: Lantern 系列五月初上市，您覺得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right after the trade show. Perfect. He'll like this plan.
scene.zh: 就在商展之後，很好。他會喜歡這個計畫的。
